english.title: Obstruct the exercise of a power to enter and inspect regulated premises
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without reasonable excuse, obstructed **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), in the exercise of a power conferred by section 62 or 63 of the Health and Social Care Act 2008

english.notes:
(i) See section 62 for the main conditions and requirements in connection with the exercise of the powers of entry and inspection.
(ii) Section 86 specifies the conditions and requirements for the Care Quality Commission to give a penalty notice in cases of fixed penalty offences.
(iii) The Health and Social Care Act 2008 (Regulated Activities) Regulations 2014 (regulation 24 and Schedule 5) prescribe fixed penalty offences for the purposes of section 86, as well as the amount of the penalties and other relevant matters. Be aware that the provisions contained in these Regulations only apply in relation to regulated activities carried on in England ).
